# (2026.6.6.234447.dev0) which ships SABR + GVS-PO-Token workarounds ahead
# of the stable channel. Without this, ``uv run`` re-resolves on every call
# and silently downgrades to the latest stable (2026.3.17) that fails 100%
# of YouTube downloads as of 2026-06-08.
prerelease = "allow"

# 2026-06-29: pin torch to the CPU-only wheel index. detoxify (engagement
# toxicity gate) pulls torch as a transitive dep. The default index ships
# the +cu12 build which pulls ~8 GB of NVIDIA CUDA wheels (nccl, cublas,
# cudnn, cusparse, cusolver, cufft, etc.). Neither prod (Hetzner Xeon, no
# GPU) nor CI (self-hosted runner on same Xeon) has CUDA, so the wheels are
# wasted bandwidth + disk. The CPU wheel is ~200 MB. Functionally identical
# for our use case (detoxify inference on short comment strings).
[[tool.uv.index]]
name = "pytorch-cpu"
url = "https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu"
explicit = true
